name: Buyer Sales Share
expression: DIVIDE([Buyer Sales],CALCULATE([Buyer Sales],REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[Party]),REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[GSTIN]),REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[Party Key])))

name: Supplier Purchases Share
expression: DIVIDE([Supplier Purchases],CALCULATE([Supplier Purchases],REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[Party]),REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[GSTIN]),REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[Party Key])))

name: Party Share
expression: DIVIDE([Party Amount],CALCULATE([Party Amount],REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[Party]),REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[Party Key]),REMOVEFILTERS('GST Parties'[GSTIN])))
description: Share of selected role and time period, removing party identity filters.

name: Credit Entries
description: Every consolidated row is one-sided. Four all-zero rows are explicitly zero-value CREDIT entries in source. Count all rows except nonzero debit entries; reconciles to 237.

name: Debit Entries
description: Nonzero debit-side entries including signed reversals; all zero-value rows in this source are credit entries. Reconciles to 645.

name: Banking Turnover
description: Consolidated MoM Summary: Net Credits. Blank means not reported.

name: Net Bank Outflows
description: Consolidated MoM Summary: Net Debits. Blank means not reported.

name: Net Credit Entries
description: Consolidated MoM Summary: Net Credit Count. Blank means not reported.

name: Cheque Return Count

name: Cheque Return Amount
description: Consolidated MoM Summary: Inward Bounce Amount. Blank means not reported.

name: EMI Return Count
description: Consolidated MoM Summary: EMI Bounce Count. Blank means not reported.

name: Penal Charges

name: Loan Disbursements

name: EMI Payments
description: Consolidated MoM Summary: EMI Payments. Blank means not reported.

name: Bank Interest Paid

name: EBIT
expression: [FY Net Profit]+[FY Interest]+[FY Current Tax]+[FY Deferred Tax]
description: PDF EBIT definition; includes non-operating other income.

name: EBITDA - PDF EBITA
description: PDF calls this EBITA but adds depreciation AND amortization; shown as EBITDA. Includes other income.

name: Operating EBIT
description: EBIT less Other Income; separate from the PDF operating-profit formula which equals EBIT.

name: Net Profit Recomputed
expression: [FY Total Income]-[FY Total Expenses]-[FY Current Tax]-[FY Deferred Tax]
description: After-tax income less expenses, reconciled to supplied PAT. Total Expenses excludes tax.

name: PAT Check
description: Should be zero; detects statement arithmetic discrepancies.

name: Total Debt
expression: [FY Long Term Debt]+[FY Short Term Debt]
description: Interest-bearing borrowings; includes disclosed unsecured debt.

name: Unsecured Debt
expression: [FY Unsecured Long Term Debt]+[FY Unsecured Short Term Debt]
description: Included in total debt; do not add twice for standard leverage.

name: Current Ratio
description: Closing current assets/current liabilities; working capital ratio uses same definition.

name: Quick Ratio
expression: DIVIDE([FY Current Assets]-[FY Inventory],[FY Current Liabilities])
description: Closing current assets less inventory/current liabilities.

name: Adjusted Debt Equity Ratio
description: No additional off-balance unsecured debt supplied; avoids double-counting debt.

name: PDF Literal Adjusted Debt Equity
description: Literal PDF formula; may double count disclosed unsecured debt, shown for traceability.

name: Interest Coverage Ratio
description: PAT-based EBIT (including other income)/finance costs. Source ratio uses a different numerator.

name: Operating Interest Coverage
description: Core operating EBIT excluding other income/finance costs; comparable to provider interest coverage.

name: Debt EBITDA Ratio
description: Total debt/PAT-based EBITDA including other income.

name: Debt Reported EBITDA
description: Total debt/source EBITDA excluding other income.

name: Reserves Equity Proxy
description: Reserves and surplus/equity; retained earnings cannot be separately identified.

name: Debtor Days
description: Closing debtors/revenue from operations x365. Credit sales unavailable.

name: Creditor Days
description: Closing creditors/purchases of stock in trade x365. Credit purchases unavailable.

name: COGS
description: Materials consumed + purchases + signed inventory change.

name: Working Capital
description: Closing current assets less current liabilities.

name: EBITDA Definition Difference
description: Difference should equal Other Income; source definitions exposed.

name: Drawing Power
description: No eligible-stock/debtor ageing or lending margins.

name: GST Period
expression: VAR A=MIN('GST Monthly'[Month]) VAR B=MAX('GST Monthly'[Month]) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(A),"No GST data in selection",FORMAT(A,"MMM yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(B,"MMM yyyy"))

name: Bank Period
expression: VAR A=MIN('Bank Monthly'[Month]) VAR B=MAX('Bank Monthly'[Month]) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(A),"No banking data in selection",FORMAT(A,"MMM yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(B,"MMM yyyy"))

name: Top Buyer Cr
expression: VAR R=RANKX(ALLSELECTED('GST Parties'[Party]),[Buyer Sales],,DESC,DENSE) RETURN IF(R<=6,[Buyer Sales Cr])

name: Top Supplier Cr
expression: VAR R=RANKX(ALLSELECTED('GST Parties'[Party]),[Supplier Purchases],,DESC,DENSE) RETURN IF(R<=6,[Supplier Purchases Cr])

name: Top Bank Receipts Cr
expression: VAR R=RANKX(ALLSELECTED('Bank Transactions'[Party]),[Gross Inflows],,DESC,DENSE) RETURN IF(R<=6,[Bank Inflows Cr])

name: Return Summary
expression: FORMAT([Cheque Return Count],"0") & " inward returns · ₹" & FORMAT([Cheque Return Amount]/100000,"0.00") & " lakh"

name: EMI Return Display
expression: IF(ISBLANK([EMI Return Count]),"Not reported",FORMAT([EMI Return Count],"0"))

name: Name Match Display
expression: FORMAT([Name Match Coverage],"0.0%") & " of receipts have an exact GST party name"

name: Finance Sales Growth
expression: VAR Y=VALUE(LEFT([Review Financial Year],4))-1 VAR P=FORMAT(Y,"0000") & "-" & FORMAT(Y+1,"0000") VAR V=CALCULATE(SUM('Financials'[Sales]),REMOVEFILTERS('Financials'),'Financials'[Financial Year]=P) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(V),DIVIDE([FY Sales]-V,V))

name: Statement Current Cr
expression: DIVIDE(SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Statement Layout'[Metric]),"FY Sales",[FY Sales],"FY Other Income",[FY Other Income],"FY Total Income",[FY Total Income],"FY Reported EBITDA",[FY Reported EBITDA],"FY Depreciation and Amortization",[FY Depreciation and Amortization],"FY Interest",[FY Interest],"FY Profit Before Tax",[FY Profit Before Tax],"FY Net Profit",[FY Net Profit],"Tangible Net Worth",[Tangible Net Worth],"Total Debt",[Total Debt],"FY Current Assets",[FY Current Assets],"FY Current Liabilities",[FY Current Liabilities],"FY Debtors",[FY Debtors],"FY Creditors",[FY Creditors],"FY Inventory",[FY Inventory],"Working Capital",[Working Capital],"FY Total Assets",[FY Total Assets]),10000000)

name: Statement Prior Cr
expression: VAR Y=VALUE(LEFT([Review Financial Year],4))-1 VAR P=FORMAT(Y,"0000") & "-" & FORMAT(Y+1,"0000") VAR Exists=COUNTROWS(FILTER(ALL('Review Year'),'Review Year'[Financial Year]=P)) RETURN IF(Exists>0,CALCULATE([Statement Current Cr],REMOVEFILTERS('Review Year'),TREATAS({P},'Review Year'[Financial Year])))

name: Statement Change
expression: VAR P=[Statement Prior Cr] RETURN IF(P>0,DIVIDE([Statement Current Cr]-P,P))
description: YoY growth only for positive prior base; negative/zero/absent prior base shown blank to avoid misleading percentages.

name: Credit Interpretation
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Credit Notes'[Topic]),"Strength","Reported PAT ₹" & FORMAT([FY Net Profit]/100000,"0.00") & " lakh. " & IF(ISBLANK([Finance Sales Growth]),"No earlier comparable revenue supplied.","Revenue changed " & FORMAT([Finance Sales Growth],"+0.0%;-0.0%") & " versus prior FY."),"Weakness","Assess PAT margin " & FORMAT([Net Profit Margin],"0.00%") & "; debt/equity " & FORMAT([Debt Equity Ratio],"0.00") & "x; core interest cover " & FORMAT([Operating Interest Coverage],"0.00") & "x.","Opportunity","Obtain receivable ageing, cash-flow and principal-repayment schedules to verify collection and debt-servicing capacity.","Threat","Historical 2024 provider litigation and GST-delay flags require current verification. No bureau score is supplied.")

name: Calculation Numeric
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[No]),1,[EBIT],2,[EBITDA - PDF EBITA],3,[FY Net Profit],4,[EBIT],7,[Current Ratio],8,[Quick Ratio],9,[Debt Equity Ratio],10,[PDF Literal Adjusted Debt Equity],11,[Interest Coverage Ratio],12,[TOL TNW Ratio],13,[Net Profit Margin],14,[Debt EBITDA Ratio],16,[Reserves Equity Proxy],17,[Debtor Days],18,[Creditor Days],19,[Stock Days],20,[Working Capital Ratio])

name: Calculation Result
expression: VAR V=[Calculation Numeric] VAR U=SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[Unit]) VAR S=SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[Evidence Status]) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(V),IF(S="Banking tab","See Banking",IF(S="Finance tab","See Finance","Not available")),SWITCH(U,"Currency","₹ " & FORMAT(V/100000,"#,0.00") & " lakh","Percent",FORMAT(V,"0.00%"),"Days",FORMAT(V,"0.0") & " days",FORMAT(V,"0.00") & "x"))

name: Calculation Color
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Calculation Register'[Evidence Status]),"Missing evidence","#B45309","Definition caveat","#A34D22","Proxy only","#A34D22","#117D75")

name: Tax and PAT Check
expression: IF(ABS([PAT Check])<0.01,"PAT reconciles to statements","PAT arithmetic needs review")

name: Bank Control Result
expression: VAR N=SELECTEDVALUE('Bank Controls'[Order]) VAR V=SWITCH(N,1,[Gross Outflows],2,[Loan Disbursements],3,[Cash Deposits],4,[EMI Payments],5,[Internal Debit],6,[Internal Credit]) RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(),N=7,[Source Penal Charges],N=8,[EMI Return Display],N=9,"Not available",ISBLANK(V),"Not reported","₹ " & FORMAT(V/10000000,"0.00") & " Cr")

name: Register Scope
expression: FORMAT([Calculation Count],"0") & " PDF parameters in view"

name: Finance Header
expression: "KPI year: " & [Review Financial Year] & "  |  Trends retain all available years"

name: PDF Header
expression: "Results for FY " & [Review Financial Year] & "  |  Currency results in lakh"
